description: Derived from AGSC-00-09 and the precedence paragraph of section 9.4: a reader validates every item against schema/item.schema.json, and a schema failure that no more specific registered code names is AGSC-E201, an error. AGSC-02-03 reads every scalar as a string and applies the schema's types, and the schema types `tags` as an array of strings. One concept is added to the minimal fixture whose `tags` is the plain scalar `agents`; every other key conforms. A type mismatch is not an enum, pattern, length, required-key or cluster-parent failure, so none of AGSC-E202, AGSC-E203, AGSC-E204 or AGSC-E308 names it. The whole list `lint` reports is one AGSC-E201 error naming that file and item, and lint exits 1. The tag count warning AGSC-E213 is not reported, because there is no list to count.
